name: 废弃货堆
prompt: Create exactly ONE transparent game prop sprite. References 1/2 are fixed style: strong dark hand-drawn contours, broad painted light and shade masses, readable forms with some brush texture; do NOT copy their pedestal. Reference 3 and 5 are approved final furniture style and localized wear. Reference 4 is the floor projection: orthographic, camera elevation45°, ground axes +/-0.7071, vertical edges vertical, tile144x101.82. Plan ground footprint BEFORE illustration; bottom contact corners must follow the template. Small top-down 3/4 view, two clear faces. Full object, generous transparent margins, NO floor/platform/pedestal/text/cast shadow. Upper-left light, restrained worn teal/ochre/cream/charcoal palette, modern industrial salvage society with repair/reuse, not medieval treasure nor nuclear wasteland. Readable at actual 144px grid scale, shape detail not photographic noise. Compact abandoned goods pile: two mismatched reusable packing crates, one dented blue plastic case and a sagging khaki cloth bundle tied by one old rope. Whole pile fills a square .90x.90 tile, height40px at tile144, coherent ground corners aligned with grid. No separate wooden pallet/plinth or loose objects outside footprint. Still full before searching. Absolutely NO halo, NO surrounding glow, NO semi-transparent smoky background. Outside the hard object silhouette must be fully transparent.
